issue_request: FHIR-40282 was a Published/Persuasive R5 OO change request for FHIR-core-DeviceDefinition. It asked to review DeviceDefinition because no elements were marked summary=true, and its resolution required summary flags on identifier; deviceName and sub-elements; modelNumber; manufacturer; classification and type; conformsTo and category, specification, and version sub-elements; and hasPart plus its reference sub-element.
initial_application: Git commit fc9235fbefcf4b1eb3287f337ac5c46785403332, subject "40282", added fourteen isSummary="true" entries to source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml for the requested elements. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-40282 existed on the combined branch before this reconciliation.
additional_context: DeviceDefinition is in current build scope through the active source/fhir.ini resource entry devicedefinition=DeviceDefinition. Later applied issue FHIR-53301 renamed DeviceDefinition.hasPart.reference to DeviceDefinition.hasPart.definition[x] and retained isSummary="true", so the current element name differs from the R5 resolution text but preserves its intent. Confluence OO WGM minutes and the Zulip tracker-list mention support the administrative/voting history and did not reveal conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made.
